To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The use of in vehicle information can improve the performance of a network by reducing the total number of stops, and (2) the effect of invehicle information is more pronounced in networks with higher level of congestion.

the use of dynamic route information in congested urban areas is beneficial, that the benefits are greater when the traffic network is more congested, that the use of information can be beneficial even in the absence of congestion, and that the use of real time information is most beneficial for drivers who are not in a hurry.

the use of in vehicle information in congested networks can improve the overall performance of the traffic network, but the magnitude of improvement depends on the information system characteristics, and on the network topology, and on the level of congestion.
